notes: Records 151-300 of PhyBook2 (parsed_items.jsonl lines 3861-4010). Coverage: the tail of static electricity (records 151-177, mostly re-exercising b23 skills) and current electricity (Physics 2nd Paper Ch3, records 178-300) split across Ohm's law and resistivity, DC circuits and Kirchhoff's laws, cells and internal resistance, and measuring instruments and bridges. Skill count is modest for 150 records because the current-electricity block is highly repetitive - dozens of near-identical resistance-network and power-consumption exercises. All descriptions are plain text with no backslashes.
